title: Petition of Edward's Limousine Service, Inc. pursuant to the provisions of G.L. c. 159A, § 7, requesting a certificate of public convenience and necessity authorizing the operation of motor vehicles for the carriage of passengers for restricted common carriage service in the Town of Medway, Milford, Hopkinton, Westborough, the City of Boston and public ways under the jurisdiction of the Massachusetts Turnpike Authority.
